scope: Synthetic host-only; no GPU, real activations, authority, network or deployment. Public fresh splits, not a blinded confirmation.
freeze: Commit this manifest and post its SHA with UTC timestamp on BOARD before running any NL7 variant. Mathematical claims below are hypotheses, not oracle results.

variants.0: exact z=((2a+b)/3,c,d), nearest 16-codeword decoder with tie refusal
variants.1: RM(1,3), f=a XOR bx XOR cy XOR dz on triples0..7, radius1 unique decoder; distance2 detection/refusal required
variants.2: learned additive z=z0+a*v1+b*v2+c*v3+d*v4, same learned receiver as NL1; explicit training-pair separation hinge
variants.3: existing NL1 learned softsign 4->3->4, unchanged optimizer and receiver

learned_protocol.initialization: existing NL1 xorshift32 and all31 parameter draws, fresh seeds
learned_protocol.additive: remove sender softsign only; receiver unchanged; after each epoch apply training-pair squared-separation hinge max(0,1/9-||z_i-z_j||^2) weighted1/10 with explicit derivative and SGD1/10; no heldout pair in loss
learned_protocol.decision: same threshold>=1/2 and abstain if any abs(score-1/2)<1/10 as NL1; invalid finite carriers refuse atomically
learned_protocol.no_tuning: One frozen run per seed/split; preserve failures. No checkpoint selection, hyperparameter changes or heldout tuning.

transport.representation: continuous: uniform nearest quantization on [-4,4] at2 or8bits per coordinate, clamp forbidden and overflow refused; IEEE binary32 or binary64 at32/64; three coordinates; remaining8bit budget's2bits are zero padding. Exact code uses [0,1] uniform quantizer at2/8bits, not [-4,4]. Packed4 baseline and RM8 padded with zeros to each matched budget. Charge full budget, also disclose payload. Codebooks/weights/schema separate receiver-side shared cost, not free communication compression.
transport.numeric_modes: 0=clean;1..6=one axis +/-1/12;7..12=one axis +/-1/6;13..18=one axis +/-1/4. Apply numeric perturbation after dequantization, no corruption of source ID. Numeric modes do not apply to binary codes.
transport.bit_modes: RM: exhaustive all8 one-bit and all28 two-bit corruptions per input; packed4: all4 one-bit and all6 two-bit corruptions per input; flip only semantic payload, not zero padding. Numeric channels do not claim ECC from numeric noise tests.

metrics: Per variant/seed/split/budget/mode: full-fit correct/16, heldout correct/8, accepted-correct, abstention/refusal, undetected wrong, exact wire bits, clean min pair squared distance and composition residual. Aggregate only after preserving each seed. All16 inputs are evaluated; training membership recorded independently.

hypotheses.exact: 16 distinct, min Euclidean distance1/3, nearest decoding for total norm<1/6 (strict; tie at boundary not guaranteed)
hypotheses.rm: 16 codewords,8bits,min Hamming4,128/128 single flips recover,448/448 double flips detected by radius1 refusal
hypotheses.additive: composition residual<=1e-12 on finite f64 values; separation term does not by itself prove global injectivity or learned receiver generalization

thresholds.exact: clean all16 at every budget, all six1/12 axis modes correct at96/192bit; 1/6 boundary and1/4 descriptive only; report low-budget quantization plus noise separately
thresholds.rm: all16 clean;128/128single flips accepted-correct;448/448double flips refused; invalid length/value atomic refusal
thresholds.additive: all three seeds achieve16/16 fullfit and8/8 heldout on BOTH fresh splits at192bits; improve over existing learned on heldout accepted-correct without raising undetected wrong; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
thresholds.overall: Exact/discrete constructions can repair synthetic recoverability without establishing learned neural communication advantage. No claim of useful compression unless matched-bit results support it.

checker: Extend NL6 using separate native Omega scorer with independent input-bit/codeword formulas; score every variant separately, derive membership from frozen lists. Mutants must challenge exact mapping/nearest tie, RM distance/radius, additive composition/separation, baseline decode and wire budget/length/finite checks. Mutant survival is FAIL, never excluded.
output_contract: CSV N,seed,split,arm,id,budget,mode,pred,status,payload_bits; status0=accepted,1=abstained/refused; pred0..15 or99. IEEE carrier dumps and parameter snapshots in separate evidence. RM modes100..107 singleflip,200+8*i+j for i<j doubleflip; packed same rule with4positions. Numeric modes0..18. Main report records full run completeness independently.
future: Johnson-Lindenstrauss projections are future work for real activations only; not tested here. Frozen source, compiler SHA, exact commands, stdout, return codes and Wolfram queries/results accompany results. No model or device evidence.
